newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia's Zagrebacka group H1 pre-tax HRK 107 mln.
newsitem.headline: Croatia's Zagrebacka group H1 pre-tax HRK 107 mln.

text.p: Croatia's Zagrebacka Banka Group said on Friday it made a consolidated pre-tax profit of 107 million kuna for the first half or 1996, compared to 117 million kuna loss in the year-ago period.
It said in a press release the retained profits for the first six months could reach 80 million kuna, based on a rough estimate of tax payable at the end of the year.
The consolidated balance sheet strengthened 8.8 percent to 18.5 billion kuna in the first six months.

Because of losses on Zagrebacka's investment in tourist industry, the group posted a loss of 184 million kuna in 1995. This was covered from a 124 million net profit of the parent company Zagrebacka Banka.
The group also includes Pomorska Banka, insurer Adriatic Osiguranje and Zagrebacka Banka Holding, which looks after the bank's stakes in tourist firms. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, 385-1-4557075
